title: Simplified Graviton memory-recipe sustained confirmation
hypothesis: KleidiAI plus mimalloc and transparent huge pages, without the regressive ONNX Runtime thread overrides, will pass five 300-second windows at 0.62 requests/s under the unchanged 10-second p95 SLO.
independent_variable: mimalloc preload and transparent huge-page policy layered on the accepted KleidiAI runtime
controls: same Phi-4 Mini INT4 artifact and pinned Arm64 runtime
same 16 threads, mixed workload, 0.62 requests/s and 10-second p95 SLO
same output digest established by EXP-2026-015 and EXP-2026-016
acceptance: all five 300-second windows pass at 0.62 requests/s
every window has zero request errors
warmup outputs match the frozen reference digest
THP mode is restored after the run
notes: The simplified mimalloc-plus-THP recipe failed all five sustained windows. This does not invalidate EXP-2026-015: the full thread, allocator, and huge-page recipe passed all five paired windows there. The release retains the complete sustained recipe and preserves this failed simplification as negative evidence.
